title: The first night
steps: The common room is very quiet, with a warm fire crackling in the fireplace and a round rug between two open arches.
These are the first-years' rooms. {The girls sleep on the left, the boys on the right|The boys sleep on the left, the girls on the right}, and you all share this common room.
Good night to the three of you, and I will see you in the morning.
Goodnight, {wizard}. I am so sleepy! I will see you tomorrow.
{friend} walks through the arch on the left, heading into the other dormitory.
Hello, {wizard}! We share this dormitory. The free bed is the one right beside mine.
{mate} walks through the arch on the right into your dormitory.
{mate} walks to the first bed, by the window.
{mate} gets into bed under the sheet and falls asleep. Now you are alone in the common room, and very tired. Your own warm bed is waiting beside {mate}'s, through the arch on the right.
